description.zh: 应用唯一标识，由6位小写字母、数字组成。
description.en: The unique identifier of the application, which consists of 6 lowercase letters and digits.

description.zh:
踢出房间时长，有效时间内不能再次进入房间，单位：秒。

- 如果不填写该字段，默认踢出300秒。

- 传0表示永久踢出房间。
description.en:
The duration for which the user is kicked out of the room. The user cannot re-enter the room within this period. Unit: seconds.

- If this parameter is not specified, the default value is 300 seconds.

- A value of 0 indicates that the user is permanently kicked out of the room.
The user ID of the user to be kicked out of the room.

description.zh: 房间的唯一标识，在调用CreateRoom时返回。
description.en: The unique identifier of the room, which is returned when you call the CreateRoom operation.

description.zh: 操作人的用户ID，用于表示谁执行了踢人操作。
description.en: The user ID of the operator, which indicates who performed the kick operation.

title.en: Kick a user out of a room
